meta.name: understand-knowledge
meta.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LLM知识库转化为交互式知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从大量文本中提取实体和关系并可视化
copy.tagline_en: Transform LLM knowledge base into interactive knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract entities and relationships from large text and visualize them

howto.what: 装上后，当用户提供 Karpathy-pattern wiki 目录，Claude 会解析文章与原始文件，提取实体、显式和隐式关系，生成知识图谱 JSON，并自动打开交互式仪表板。
howto.when: 当用户调用 /understand-knowledge 并指定目录（缺省为当前目录）时触发；若目录无 index.md 与带 wikilinks 的 .md 文件，会报错并说明期望。

howto.what_en: When given a Karpathy-pattern wiki directory, Claude parses articles and raw sources, extracts entities and both explicit and implicit relations, merges them into a knowledge graph JSON, and auto-opens the interactive dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user invokes /understand-knowledge with a directory argument (defaults to the current directory). If the directory lacks index.md and wikilinked .md files, it reports an error and explains the expectation.

say_en.note: Detects structure and builds the graph.
